verdict.rationale: Meltano is open-source, self-hosted, and pipeline configs live as code/YAML in your own git repo (docs-18, docs-21, docs-29), and data is loaded directly into destinations you own (databases, files, warehouses) rather than a proprietary store — inherently avoiding lock-in. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data-export feature, supported open output formats, or migration/exit tooling; it's an architectural inference rather than a stated capability. Missing for 10: explicit 'export your data' documentation, named open file formats/standards supported on egress, and any hands-on account of migrating away from Meltano.
